Mr. H. L. Fiedler State Highway Engineer Division of Highways 4802 Sheyboygan Avenue Madison, Wisconsin 53702
Dear Mr. Fiedler:
This letter will comment on the Draft Environmental Statement Airport Spur, I-94 to General Mitchell Field in Milwaukee.
First on page 90, the fourth and third lines from the bottom, state "at least 90 percent from the uncontrolled 1971 levels". The word uncontrolled should be stricken since controls were present in 1971 models.
Second, your computations show the contribution to the atmosphere of the various alternatives. However, they do not provide an estimate of the effect on an individual, i.e., the local effects of the different alternatives. Since people living next to the proposed route will be interested in the effect on them if the route is built and people adjacent to the streets that will be used if the route is not built will or should be interested in the effect on them. I think such estimations would be worth while even though I recognize the uncertainties in the estimations.
